title: auth 16: /msg mimid login: RFC 8628's device flow over NOTICE, so social login works in every IRC client
description: The elegant one for IRC, and it needs no client support at all: /msg mimid login replies with a URL and a user code, the user approves in a browser, and the service nick confirms and hands back a credential. RFC 8628 carried over plain NOTICE text, so it works in Goguma, HexChat, WeeChat, irssi and everything else, where SASL OAUTHBEARER (RFC 7628) works in none of them (*unverified per client; decision mimid-1wgh.125*). Needs the provider's device grant (bead mimid-hb5z.7) and the service-nick command surface that /msg mimid passwords already uses. Note the NOTICE caveat of decision A5: most IRC clients log every line to disk, so the credential line warns, as the password add line does.
